public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 40

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section


namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture40

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α] (G : SimpleGraph α)

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 40](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a nontrivial connected graph `G` the size `f(G)` of a largest induced forest
satisfies `f(G) ≥ ceil((p(G) + b(G) + 1)/2)` where `p(G)` is the path cover
number and `b(G)` is the largest induced bipartite subgraph size.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture40 (h_conn : G.Connected) (h_nontrivial : 1 < Fintype.card α) :
    ⌈(((pathCoverNumber G : ℝ) + b G + 1) / 2)⌉ ≤  G.largestInducedForestSize := by
  sorry

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture40

review.notes: The sole theorem faithfully states the source's inequality for simple connected graphs with more than one vertex. All three graph invariants match the source's definitions, including vertex-disjoint paths that need not be induced. The additional Nontrivial instance is redundant, not restrictive. Scratch Lean checks verified path-cover existence, bounded forest candidates, empty/singleton cases, the invariants of K₂ and K₃, and the K₂ instance of the inequality. The ceiling expression was proved equivalent to the corresponding natural-number inequality p + b + 1 ≤ 2f, without using sorryAx. The available July 2026 source marks Conjecture 40 open; the live site's HTTPS endpoint was unavailable, so archived primary sources were used.
